data.name: 幻兽纪元
data.detailed_description:
*Fantasy Beast Era* is a fantasy 2D adventure side-scrolling RPG set on the continent of Saint Terius, weaving a thrilling saga of salvation. In the year 98 of the Saint Terius calendar, mysterious invaders ravaged the land, reducing Green Field Village to ruins and displacing its inhabitants. Years later, a young man possessing the power of divine revelation accidentally finds a celestial book and returns to his homeland, determined to uncover the truth behind the village's destruction. Guided by the wise Merlin, the young man awakens the inherited power of the Beast Master, taming various magical beasts with extraordinary abilities. Through countless trials, he ultimately drives out the demonic beasts, restoring light to the sacred land.

Contract with magical beasts, awaken divine lineage, and team up to explore—reverse time on an epic continent eroded by the abyss, and write your own legendary adventure!

The magical beasts that once protected the world have been controlled by the abyss, the power of the ancient gods has scattered in all directions, and rifts in spacetime are spreading. The abyss's Sien attempts to steal the power of the gods and summon the ultimate portal to spacetime.

The only hope is to turn back time to before the abyss descended…

▌Eight Adventurer Characters – Embark on Your Journey Now

The horn of destiny has sounded, and the perilous continent awaits the arrival of true adventurers—

The “Holy Swordsman” forged with an iron will, the “Ice Spellcaster” who wields the laws of extreme cold, the “Shadow Dancer” who walks the line between reality and illusion, the “Wind Whisperer” who listens to the rhythm of the storm, the “Demon Warrior” who unleashes crimson cherry blossom lightning, the “Little Red Riding Hood” who awakens a scarlet soul, the “Chosen One” who bears the destiny to slay demons, and the “Miya” who plays the purifying hymns of the world—all have answered the call of adventure.

Choose your path now and write your legend!

▌Core System – Forge Bonds, Forge Divine Miracles

【Phantom Beast System】Capture elemental phantom beasts and forge soul contracts! The power of phantom beasts will flow into your bloodline, assisting in battle, evolving, awakening… Only by standing shoulder to shoulder with phantom beasts of compatible affinity can you break through the boundaries of power!

Elemental interactions, strategic combinations lead to victory; pet retraction without loss, boldly cultivate ultimate partners!

【Alchemy System】

Refine divine artifacts, imbuing equipment with soul! Lossless reinforcement inheritance, refining locks in key elements; every forging is a pursuit of the path of master craftsmanship.

【Trial System】

Traverse secret realms, explore misty lands, accumulating adventure rewards even offline! Even when temporarily away from the game, the trials continue—cross levels to seize treasures, aiding your adventure.

【Divine Transformation System】

Awaken the dormant ancient divine veins, break through the limits of the mortal body, and awaken your divine power! Divine power, transformation to the peak, a single move decides the fate of the world!

Adventurers, the holy land awaits your arrival! Warriors gather from all directions, will you be one of them? —The abyss has arrived, the brave shall return!
